title: J. Allen Hynek refuses to join a research meeting on Owens

tellings.quote: and we actually coraled JL and Heinik to show up and his attitude was I wouldn't go near Ted Owens with a 10-ft bowl.

plain: Jeffrey Mishlove, a researcher with a doctorate who studied psychic claims, says that in the late 1970s he and others got the astronomer J. Allen Hynek, long an adviser to the US Air Force's UFO study, to come to a meeting about Ted Owens, a man who claimed unusual powers. According to Mishlove, Hynek's attitude was that he would not go near Ted Owens with a ten-foot pole. Mishlove was there and tells it as a sign of how wary even UFO scientists were of Owens.
